first_saturation_knee.attribution_boundary: The load generator and API share one physical host, so client HTTP scheduling and host contention cannot be isolated as a remote-generator network result.

s2_capacity_recalculation.decision: Retain the prior depth because the calculated value is only five requests higher and automatic increase is disabled.

topology_result.interpretation: Adding colocated API replicas or CPU workers did not produce linear scaling. Shared-host scheduling and queue contention dominated this overload point.

failed_attempts_and_rca.observed: One transport failure among 2,984 attempts invalidated the entire point.
failed_attempts_and_rca.root_cause: The evidence assertion required zero transport errors even though S3 is designed to measure an error-rate curve.
failed_attempts_and_rca.remediation: Retain transport failures in error-rate telemetry, require deterministic client identity for every attempt, and require W3C response identity for every server response.

failed_attempts_and_rca.observed: Four of 52 sampled chains were absent from a one-shot exporter-tail read.
failed_attempts_and_rca.root_cause: A fixed sleep followed by one read was not a bounded trace-completion contract.
failed_attempts_and_rca.remediation: Poll the exporter within a frozen timeout and fail closed if expected chains remain incomplete.

failed_attempts_and_rca.observed: Two sampled chains remained missing after API termination and the bounded poll.
failed_attempts_and_rca.root_cause: Windows process termination could discard BatchSpanProcessor data before export.
failed_attempts_and_rca.remediation: Complete bounded trace export while the API process is alive, then stop it and rehash the final tail.

failed_attempts_and_rca.observed: A mixed 200, 429, and transport overload point failed the successful six-span requirement.
failed_attempts_and_rca.root_cause: The trace assertion did not distinguish successful execution, admission rejection, and client-only transport outcomes.
failed_attempts_and_rca.remediation: Require full spans for 200, route plus admission spans for server rejection, and client identity without fabricated server spans for transport failure.

claim_boundary: Measured lightweight HIGGS CPU/API capacity, bounded process-local queue behavior, external TCP/HTTP request handling, Prometheus telemetry, W3C trace attribution, and colocated replica/worker comparisons on one local physical node. No production or customer traffic, SLA, physical multi-node or multi-zone HA, stateful HA/DR, multi-GPU, business A/B, or terabyte-throughput claim.
